permissions.calendar_tasks_write: Required for task mutations and list creation, rename, deletion, sort and stored selection. Writes check this permission independently of Calendar event or ACL permissions.
permissions.registration: Missing or unknown bearer token returns 401; denied task permission returns 403; another account resource ID is not found (404). Current account permissions are checked on every operation.
permissions.readonly_ui: Mutation controls are disabled; selecting a different list changes local UI state only.

validation.task_title: String, nonblank, at most 1024 characters before trim; stored trimmed.
validation.notes: String at most 8192 characters; preserved without trimming.
validation.due: Strict ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, normalized to YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z; null or empty removes due; no scheduled time.
validation.starred_and_deleted: Boolean only. New-task payload cannot set deleted. A deleted task can only be restored by the exact patch {deleted: false}.
validation.status: needsAction or completed; completion sets completed if absent, reopening removes completed.
validation.list_title: String, nonblank, at most 1024 characters before trim; stored trimmed.
validation.atomicity: Validation occurs before resource mutation. Supplied tests cover invalid task/list payloads, non-task state preservation and account isolation.

mutation: Inline title/details/date save on Enter in title (except Shift+Enter), focus moving to an identified control outside the form, or closing Tasks. Closing waits for save and stays open if save fails.
Other row/list actions first attempt to save the current task draft. Unchanged task edits close without a write.
Completion/reopen, star, soft delete and latest task-delete undo preserve the task ID. List creation selects the new list; deleted selected lists fall back to default.
Task/list saved results are cached before follow-up GET. Row mutations are serialized. Draft field values are retained through normal rerenders.
Current source invalidates outstanding reads at newer read, mutation and draft transitions. Current source forces Completed open while it contains the edited completed task.
cancellation: An empty new task draft is discarded without a write.
Escape discards an unsaved task draft while no save is pending; Discard changes is offered after write failure.
List-form Cancel returns to task state without submitting the list change. Cancelling list deletion leaves the list and tasks unchanged.
Closing a nonempty changed task draft is a save action, not cancellation.
failures: Initial read failure retains the panel and exposes Retry.
Failed task mutation retains draft values and exposes Retry/Discard changes; failed list mutation retains name input for retry.
When a write succeeded but refresh failed, retain saved cache, say Task saved/Change saved/List saved with refresh error, and provide Reload tasks. Reload does not resubmit the accepted mutation.
Generation/revision guards discard older or closed-panel GET responses. Source/VM evidence does not establish native browser focus correctness.

readme_proposal.markdown:
### Tasks side panel

The Calendar Tasks controls open a personal Tasks pane within the incumbent
Calendar interface: a 320px white pane on desktop and a full-width drawer below
the header on narrow screens. It supports task lists, inline title/details and
date-only editing, stars, completion/reopening, and task deletion with Undo.
List controls create, rename, select and delete lists, and sort by stored order,
date, title or starred-first. The current “Starred recently” option groups starred
tasks; it does not track when they were starred. The default My Tasks list cannot
be deleted. Deleting another list also soft-deletes its tasks and returns the
selection to the default list; list deletion has no Undo control.

Task drafts save on Enter in the title, focus moving to another control, or
closing Tasks. Empty new drafts and unchanged edits make no write. Escape
cancels an unsaved task draft; failed writes retain its fields and offer Retry or
Discard changes. List forms retain failed input and support Cancel, and list
deletion requires confirmation. A successful mutation is cached before refresh:
if the follow-up read fails, the saved task or list remains visible with an
explicit refresh error and Reload tasks action, without repeating the write.
Stale reads are discarded after newer reads, mutations or draft transitions.
A completed task stays expanded while its inline editor is open.

The account's native `google_calendar` state contains `task_lists`, `side_tasks`
and `task_preferences.selectedListId`; `GET /_admin/state` exposes those three
keys for inspection. Tasks are personal and do not mutate Calendar events,
sharing ACLs or other accounts. Reads require `calendar_tasks_read`; mutations,
including saved list selection and sorting, require `calendar_tasks_write`.
Registered bearer tokens are required, and permission changes apply to existing
tokens. Read-only users can browse their own lists without writing preferences.
Task and list titles are nonempty and limited to 1,024 characters; task details
are limited to 8,192. Dates accept `YYYY-MM-DD` and store date-only `due` values
at midnight UTC; clearing the date removes `due`. Invalid fields reject the
entire mutation.

The routes under `/calendar/_ui/tasks` and `/calendar/_ui/task-lists` are private
browser resources, not the public Google Tasks API. This extension does not
implement task time, recurrence, deadlines, subtasks, attachments, Calendar-grid
projection, fullscreen Tasks, other side apps, or cross-product delivery.
Source regressions and supplied desktop/390px Chrome evidence cover the bounded
flows; native keyboard/focus, physical touch and unnamed expanded-menu controls
in the CUA accessibility tree remain unresolved. This is not independent visual
approval, complete provider parity, or approval of the full eight-twin release.
